provenanceContract.sourceMetadataResolution: Each external overlap resolves source repository, exact reviewed revision, licence, and runtime-dependency status by sourceId through docs/method-sources.json.
provenanceContract.candidateImplementationRule: An adapt-local or vendor-slice candidate is not adopted code or guidance until a focused implementation PR cites the sourceId and exact revision, records modifications, preserves required notices, and adds evidence or tests for the retained benefit.
provenanceContract.observationRule: Observe and reject entries are not runtime dependencies and do not authorize copying upstream material.

domainBoundaries.scope: Generic visual design engineering methods and specialist review guidance.
Lifecycle, role isolation, evidence, routing, acceptance, resume, and supported runtime behaviour.
Offer, positioning, persuasion strategy, and authoritative copy. Design Studio consumes approved artifacts through skills/design-studio/references/copy.md.

duplicateResolutions.condition: Delete after issues #48 and #51 migrate every supported routing/reference that still depends on this legacy methodology document and clean-install validation proves no runtime path requires it.

triggers: Generating competing visual directions before implementation
Evaluating a direction or implementation without exposing source identity

externalOverlaps.methodName: genuinely divergent prototypes compared in realistic context
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Adapt only the divergence criterion and realistic-context comparison. Preserve Design Studio's source-blind role split, evidence model, and local routing; do not copy the upstream prototype directory structure or tooling.

triggers: Every supported run and resume boundary
Before evidence mutation, transition, or acceptance
Run setup and resume
Before direction work relies on product facts, constraints, or existing state

externalOverlaps.methodName: design command taxonomy as lifecycle routing
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: No upstream lifecycle or command taxonomy is imported. Design Studio retains its own phase model and progressively disclosed local references.

triggers: Implementing an accepted direction
Changing rendered UI while preserving the accepted design intent
Collecting source or browser evidence before visual evaluation
Re-checking a changed implementation after review fixes

externalOverlaps.methodName: deterministic source/browser audit checks with explicit finding severity
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Adapt only repeatable checks and finding semantics that can be implemented locally and protected by tests. Keep Design Studio's evidence schema and do not require the Impeccable CLI or prompt library at runtime.

externalOverlaps.methodName: mechanical evidence separated from visual judgement
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: No separate upstream authority is imported because the local quality-gate and evaluation contracts already make this separation explicit.

triggers: Iterating after evaluator or orchestrator findings
Performing final design review on a visually mature implementation

externalOverlaps.methodName: read-only expert audit followed by an executable improvement plan
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Adapt the audit-to-plan handoff shape only. Preserve source-blind evaluation, immutable evidence, and orchestrator decision ownership; reviewers do not gain acceptance authority.

externalOverlaps.methodName: broad design command taxonomy for review routing
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Do not import a parallel command framework. Existing local review leaves remain the routing surface, with future compression handled by issue #51.

triggers: Reviewing interactive, navigable, form, or public-facing UI
Evidence indicates contrast, focus, semantics, target-size, or reduced-motion risk

externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Keep as a comparison source only. The local accessibility leaf remains canonical unless a specific missing defect class is demonstrated.
evidenceBasis: local a11y review leaf already exists

triggers: Reviewing hierarchy, spacing rhythm, density, or responsive composition
Rendered evidence shows layout ambiguity or breakpoint degradation

externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Retain only as a pinned comparison source. No local material is replaced until a targeted missing rule is evidenced.
evidenceBasis: local hierarchy review leaf already exists

triggers: Reviewing interactive states, affordances, feedback, or control behaviour
Rendered evidence shows unclear hover, focus, active, loading, empty, or error state behaviour

externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Retain as a pinned comparison source. The local interaction leaf is the sole authority unless a specific missing state pattern is demonstrated.
evidenceBasis: local interaction review leaf already exists

triggers: Adding, changing, or reviewing UI motion
Motion affects hierarchy, feedback, interruption, perceived responsiveness, or reduced-motion behaviour

externalOverlaps.methodName: purpose and frequency gate for motion
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Adapt the explicit purpose/frequency decision gate into the local motion review path. Preserve product context and reduced-motion requirements; do not turn upstream preferences into universal rules.

externalOverlaps.methodName: precise motion values and interruptibility rules
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Adapt bounded value ranges and interruptibility checks as contextual review heuristics, not fixed framework-specific prescriptions.
When a motion audit is routed, record concise negative decisions in run evidence so future passes do not re-propose purposeless motion. Do not create permanent documentation noise for ordinary runs.

externalOverlaps.methodName: generic motion guidance inside the wider design method
externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Observe only; the bounded Emil motion methods are the clearer intake candidates and the local interaction leaf remains canonical.

triggers: Reviewing generated UI for generic, repetitive, redundant, or over-produced patterns
Rendered evidence feels synthetic despite meeting mechanical checks

externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Adapt only defect categories that map to recurring local evidence. Keep Design Studio terminology and product-specific judgement; do not import the upstream command framework or full prompt text.
evidenceBasis: Horaxon dogfood findings referenced by issue #43

A project requests or benefits from durable tokens, components, or design-system skill output

externalOverlaps.modificationProvenance: Retain as a pinned comparison source only. The local design-system template remains canonical until a concrete missing codification behaviour is demonstrated.
